description:
Aggregated DeFi perpetual funding rates across venues. Positive funding means longs are paying to hold; negative means shorts are. Use it when the user asks about perp funding, crowded positioning or leverage bias.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: get_perp_funding_rates
